texts.en:
As the Arkship [Root.GetName] continues to drift, the observation decks have erupted in delight. A pod of juvenile tiyanki has passed nearby, and they seem to be in a playful mood.

They weave around each other in broad, looping arcs, their vast forms tumbling around one another. From the wide glass panes, the sight is mesmerizing: colossal shapes floating among the stars, their luminous bodies glimmering while seemingly communicating in a language only they could understand. Entire families crowd the decks to watch, momentarily letting go of their burdens. It is a true wonder for all ages.

label.zh: 一次难得的观察太空兽群行为的机会。
label.en: A rare opportunity to observe space fauna behavior.

texts.zh:
方舟号[Root.GetName]上的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]对缇扬奇幼兽同样着迷。如此近距离观察这种行为几乎是前所未有的。我们的研究表明，这是一种社会现象，在缇扬奇深层栖息地以外很少观察到。

方舟号上的整体气氛现在变得更加轻松，仿佛动物们的喜悦渗透了整个船舱。
texts.en:
Our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] aboard the Arkship [Root.GetName] were no less enthralled by the Tiyanki calves. To witness such behavior at this proximity is almost unprecedented. Our studies suggest this was a social phenomenon that is rarely observed outside deep Tiyanki habitats.

The general atmosphere aboard the Arkship now feels lighter, as if the animals' joy permeates the hull.

# 巨兽的游乐场 / A Playground of Giants

- 分类 Category：银河轶事 C8 stories · 来源 Sources：events/nomads_arkship_events.txt、common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt、common/special_projects/06_projects_nomads.txt、common/event_chains/00_event_chains_nomads.txt · 游牧帝国内容 nomad content · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13

## 如何开始 How it starts

游牧帝国的方舟随机事件：隐藏事件 arkship.1（nomads_arkship_events.txt:7-49）定期检查，游戏前5年不会发生，每次约三分之一几率（中期前×1.5；近期参战或所有方舟都在战斗时为0）调用 generate_arkship_event 从 mobile_arkship_random_events 池（00_on_actions.txt:3979-4006，24项，总权重460）中抽取一件，否则3–5年后再试。多数事件设置一次性标记（个别如“出发！”可发生两次）；结束后约10–15年再重新开始检查。（池中权重 20/460，00_on_actions.txt:3993）
Nomad arkship random event: hidden arkship.1 (nomads_arkship_events.txt:7-49) checks periodically — never in the first 5 years, about one in three (×1.5 before mid game, 0 during recent war or when every arkship is fighting) — and draws one episode from mobile_arkship_random_events (00_on_actions.txt:3979-4006, 24 entries, total weight 460); otherwise it retries in 3–5 years. Most episodes set a once-only flag (Start Your Engines can happen twice); after it ends the loop resumes roughly 10–15 years later. (pool weight 20/460, 00_on_actions.txt:3993)

条件：方舟所在星系有缇扬奇；非格式塔；只发生一次。
Conditions: Tiyanki in the system; non-gestalt; once.

- 一群幼年缇扬奇在方舟旁嬉戏 → 观察 → 约半年后“科学奇迹”。
  Juvenile Tiyanki play around the arkship → observe → A Scientific Miracle about six months later.
